history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1812 in Sweden and came to Chicago about 1862. He works as a printer, and the household lives in the city's outer streets. The family's church is Our Saviour's.
